BillHeading.BriefDescription: Extending the joint center for aerospace technology innovation program.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the joint center for aerospace technology innovation; and amending RCW 43.131.417 and 43.131.418.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 43.131.417 and 2013 2nd sp.s. c 24 s 2 are each amended to read as follows:Joint center for aerospace technology innovation—Termination.
BillSection.P: The joint center for aerospace technology innovation shall be terminated July 1, 2020 2030, as provided in RCW 43.131.418.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 2. RCW 43.131.418 and 2014 c 112 s 122 are each amended to read as follows:Joint center for aerospace technology innovation—Repeal.
BillSection.P: The following acts or parts of acts, as now existing or hereafter amended, are each repealed, effective July 1, 2021 2031:
